Recovery paths overview
EAC bans and hardware flags on Epic need different recovery paths. Spoofing when you only need a new account—or buying a fresh identity when your PC is HWID locked—wastes time and money.
This guide maps symptoms to fixes and shows where [HWID Spoofer](/products/fortnite-cheats/hwid-spoofer/) and [Account Recovery](/products/fortnite-cheats/ugc/) fit.
Account ban vs HWID flag
Account EAC ban: explicit ban message on Epic profile, Fortnite shows restricted matchmaking on that account only.
HWID flag: fresh accounts fail within minutes on the same PC but work on another machine. Multiple new accounts dying instantly on one rig points to hardware enforcement first.
When to use HWID spoofer

If Epic flagged your PC identifiers and your main account is otherwise clean—or you are moving to a new account after learning—run the guided [HWID Spoofer](/products/fortnite-cheats/hwid-spoofer/) workflow.
Steps: restore point, compatibility scan, spoof, cold reboot, verify serials in portal checker before launching Epic. Never stack two spoof tools from different vendors.
When to start a new account
Permanent account EAC on your main identity often means fresh Epic account plus behavioral reset—not spoof alone.
Wait 48 hours of normal play before enabling any [fortnite cheats](/products/fortnite-cheats/) modules. Same payment method and phone on repeat ban lineages re-flag fast.
When not to spoof
Skip spoofing on shared family PCs, work laptops, or when ban is account-only shadow queue issues.
